evidence_precedence.rule: The working-tree bytes and Git blob ID for every imported path match the named source ref and commit.
A result, receipt, postmortem, or integrity audit may support only the outcome and scope it records; a recorded verdict is not a broader authorization.
These records establish prospective design, data custody, or recovery requirements; they do not create an execution result when marked prospective, blocked, or withdrawn.
These records support engineering, mechanical, preflight, no-update, or partial-execution claims only; they do not imply cognition, AGI, production readiness, or scale authorization.

evidence_classes.PRIMARY_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT: Narrow observed scientific outcome with an explicit result boundary.
evidence_classes.PRIMARY_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT_PARTIAL: Observed or budget-limited scientific result that is not a complete authorized campaign.
evidence_classes.PREREGISTRATION_PROTOCOL: Prospective protocol, design, surface, or amendment record; not an outcome by itself.
evidence_classes.PREEXECUTION_ENGINEERING: Operator qualification, readiness, preflight, or engineering audit; not capability evidence.
evidence_classes.POSTMORTEM_AUDIT: Post-outcome audit or interpretation; it does not silently replace the frozen result.
evidence_classes.CUSTODY_RECOVERY: Artifact identity, recovery, or checkpoint-custody record; it does not change a scientific verdict.
evidence_classes.EVALUATION_INTEGRITY_AUDIT: Evaluation validity, shortcut, leakage, firewall, or causal-sensitivity audit.
evidence_classes.DATA_READINESS_AUDIT: Data-materialization, contamination, supply, and production-readiness audit.
evidence_classes.MINIATURE_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT: Small-scale prospective A/B or wiring evidence with no capability or production inference.
evidence_classes.ENGINEERING_PARTIAL_RESULT: Partial engineering execution with explicit blocked or unrun phases.
evidence_classes.ENGINEERING_BUILD_NO_UPDATE: Build, contract, or zero-update verification; not training or cognition evidence.
evidence_classes.BLOCKED_ENGINEERING_READINESS: Readiness record that says not executed or do not run and records unresolved defects.
evidence_classes.PROVENANCE_DIAGNOSTIC: Replay, ledger, or custody diagnostic that cannot establish causal ranking or recovery.
